name: Spiko Amundi Overnight Swap Fund
oneLiner: SAFO is the USD share of the Spiko/Amundi UCITS sub-fund using fully collateralized overnight TRS with tier-1 banks; a NAV-accreting share, not $1-pegged.
collateral: USD share class of Spiko Amundi Overnight Swap Fund. Physical bonds, equities and money-market instruments are hedged through portfolio-wide total-return swaps with one or more counterparties; BNP Paribas is the identified counterparty and CACEIS Bank the depositary. Counterparty default can expose underlying security and currency risks.
pegMechanism: USD-denominated NAV-accreting UCITS share class with KYC-gated subscriptions and redemptions at daily fund NAV through Spiko. Orders are centralized by 15:00 Paris time; ordinary redemption settles D+1, subject to the currency market being open. The management company may cap redemptions when net requests reach 25% of sub-fund net assets; the trigger is the same for all share classes, with at most 20 valuation days of capping over three months. Unexecuted orders carry over without priority; suspension and swing pricing can also limit or delay exit.

proofOfReserves.provider: Issuer-filed Spiko SICAV semiannual financial disclosure covering the SAFO sub-fund and its share classes, not a signed audit opinion. PricewaterhouseCoopers Audit is the named statutory auditor; no SAFO-specific financial audit opinion or complete current all-share-class/native-register reconciliation was retrieved.

The issuer share-class API identifies eight native registers and five share decimals; the 21 October 2026 fund inventory contains 100 physical equity rows, one cash row and eight signed swap legs under counterparty code 372039-BNP, with TRS at approximately 100% of net assets. This supports ucits-trs-fund, not direct Treasury or credit-fund backing, and it does not establish complete current NAV, collateral, netting or default-recovery reconciliation.
